literal: From the lovers' quarrel appearing small distress, good affection even if it fades, greatness will get.
translation: The slight distress that arises from a lovers' quarrel brings a sweet reward, even if it makes their good affection seem to fade.
modern: காதலர்களிடையே ஏற்படும் ஊடலால் தோன்றும் சிறிய துன்பம், அவர்களின் நல்ல அன்பினைச் சிறிது நேரம் வாடச் செய்தாலும், முடிவில் இன்பம் என்னும் பெருமையைப் பெறும்.
explanation: This couplet explores the emotional value of a lovers' quarrel. The word 'ஊடல்' refers to the feigned anger or sulking between lovers, which causes a 'சிறுதுனி' or slight distress. Although this temporary distress might make their deep affection ('அளி') seem to fade ('வாடினும்') for a moment, it ultimately brings a greater sweetness or value ('பாடு') to their relationship when they reunite. The contrast between the temporary fading of affection and the gaining of greatness highlights how such quarrels only serve to strengthen love.
